reading.title: Two Words in One
reading.purpose: Hear how two small words can make one big word.
paras: Some words are made of two small words. Back and pack make backpack. Rain and bow make rainbow.
Play and ground make playground. Bed and time make bedtime. Butter and fly make butterfly. Which one can you draw? Say each big word with me.

qs.q: Which two small words make backpack?
qs.why: The reading says back and pack make backpack.

qs.q: Which big word has the small word bed in it?
Which big word has the small word fly in it?

reading.retellFrame: Two small words, ___ and ___, make one big word.
